description: Header file defining the finite-state machine (FSM) for uplink processor management, including state transitions, notifications, and concurrency control mechanisms.

classes.name: uplink_processor_fsm
classes.description: Implements a finite-state machine managing the states and transitions of an uplink processor, including handling PDUs, slot discarding, and PRACH detection.

classes.name: uplink_processor_fsm_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the FSM about PDU count changes and acceptance status.

methods.name: start_new_slot
methods.description: Transitions the FSM to accept PDUs for a specified slot if currently idle.

methods.name: has_receive_request
methods.description: Checks if the processor has receive requests associated with a given slot.

methods.name: stop_accepting_pdu
methods.description: Removes the accepting PDU mask, indicating the FSM stops accepting new PDUs.

methods.name: increment_pending_pdu_count
methods.description: Increments the count of pending PDUs, indicating a new PDU is being processed.

methods.name: start_discard_slot
methods.description: Begins discarding the current slot, transitioning the FSM to a locked state if conditions permit.

methods.name: finish_discard_slot
methods.description: Completes slot discarding, returning the FSM to idle state.

methods.name: start_handle_rx_symbol
methods.description: Begins handling a receive symbol, locking the FSM if conditions are met.

methods.name: finish_handle_rx_symbol
methods.description: Completes handling a receive symbol, unlocking the FSM.

methods.name: on_create_pdu_task
methods.description: Indicates creation of a new PDU processing task, incrementing the execution count.

methods.name: on_finish_processing_pdu
methods.description: Marks completion of a PDU processing, decrementing the pending count.

methods.name: on_prach_detection
methods.description: Attempts to increment PRACH detection task count if allowed.

methods.name: on_end_prach_detection
methods.description: Marks completion of a PRACH detection task, decrementing the count.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the FSM, waiting for ongoing tasks to complete.
